newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Sandoz sees full-year growth similar to H1.
newsitem.headline: Sandoz sees full-year growth similar to H1.

text.p: Swiss pharmaceuticals group Sandoz AG said it was confident operating results would continue to develop favourably in 1996 with net income growth comparable to the development in the first half.
"Making allowance for merger-related special items, net income growth for the full year is likely to be comparable to the development in the first half," Sandoz said in a statement.
Sandoz has agreed to merge with Ciba-Geigy AG, pending regulatory approvals.
Sandoz first-half net profit rose 12 percent to 1.241 billion Swiss francs. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
